portInfo.description: Ireland's vibrant capital, a historic port city known for its literary heritage, pubs, and excellent cruise facilities.

climate.rainySeason: Year-round with higher precipitation in autumn and winter
climate.description: Oceanic climate with mild temperatures year-round

politics.visaRequirements: Entry and visa rules depend on nationality and itinerary. Confirm requirements with official government sources and your cruise line before travel; rules can change.
politics.entryRequirements: Carry a valid passport (or a national ID where your cruise line and destination authorities accept it). Cruise transit formalities can differ from a normal airport entry—follow your ship’s document list.
